sourceFile: 17.2 BRS 161016 Report check dimension compare CD vendor Ralon and GES 2024.02.18_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft captures a Ralon vs GES dimension comparison but is not reliable as final evidence.
issues: Evidence includes rows beyond reported sheet length.
Changed factor uses filename instead of vendor comparison.
Merged vendor labels are not propagated to samples.
Outcomes mix CD, detected-table, and position data without clear grouping.
correctionPlan: Recheck source row extraction and remove invalid row citations.
Set changed factor to vendor: Ralon vs GES.
Treat dimension/CD and positions as outcomes, not changed factors.
Fill down vendor labels for all sample rows before computing stats.
Separate or justify multiple measurement tables under one report context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are insufficient until invalid and header-only citations are replaced with citeable vendor/sample data rows.
